summary: Smooths time-varying point, primitive or vertex attributes with filtering, lag and freeze stages.

key_params.name: filtertype
key_params.note: Window filters or adaptive One Euro filtering.

key_concepts: One Euro filtering trades jitter reduction against response time.
Stable particle IDs associate changing point sets across frames.
common_gotchas: Use PartId when particle membership or ordering changes.
Long history windows increase memory; Increment reduces stored history.
Verify temporal response rather than only checking output existence.
Live 2025.33230 uses filtertype, although the docs label it type; inspect the current build before writing.
